newsitem.title: USA: Philadelphia cops collar Barbie doll bandits.
newsitem.headline: Philadelphia cops collar Barbie doll bandits.

text.p: - Three security guards were arrested on Thursday, charged with stealing 42 Barbie dolls.
Police arrested the guards after scrutinising security videotapes taken at the FAO Schwarz toy store in the King of Prussia Mall on Monday, Police Lt. Robert Deuber said.
Searches conducted Tuesday recovered the dolls, the total worth more than $2,000 at retail prices, as well as other merchandise, he said.
Deuber added that the demand for Barbie dolls is high enough to command a price close to retail. "If there's a market out there, I guess somebody will try to fill it."
